name: What kind of maintenance is needed after fire damage restoration?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is needed after fire damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: After fire damage restoration, maintenance often involves inspecting the integrity of the repaired structures, checking HVAC systems for smoke residue, and monitoring air quality. It may also include cleaning soot-affected areas that could not be fully cleaned during the initial restoration and addressing any lingering odors. Regular checks help ensure the property remains safe and comfortable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance after fire damage includes inspecting structures, checking HVAC, monitoring air quality, and addressing lingering soot or odors.
